title: Fontainebleau 335
meta_description: Fontainebleau 335 is a cozy beachfront studio in Panama City Beach with a pool, kitchenette, and sunset deck---steps from dining, drinks \& the sand.
description_expanded:
Nestled in the heart of Panama City Beach, Fl. lies the most iconic historical building of our area, the closest to the water, with a fabulous partially covered pool! This cozy updated unit features a full bathroom, kitchenette, queen bed, and a 5th floor open air deck to snap amazing sunset photos during your stay. Walk to Starbucks or the incredible Runaway Island for drinks and dinner overlooking the gulf or grab fresh seafood from Local Steamer just down the street.

Please note, only starter amenities are provided, you will need to purchase additional toilet paper, trash bags and laundry detergent etc.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure views, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: St. Andrews State Park, Camp Helen State Park, Ms. Newby's and Runaway Island (karaoke), Jimmy Buffett's Margaritaville, Pier Park, Gulf World Marine Park, Water Planet, Little Village Waterfront Shopping Market, SkyWheel, Shipwreck Island Waterpark.

Home Truths:
- Please be sure to read and follow all house rules.
- There is no washer/dryer in the unit. A coin-operated laundry is available for guest use and is located on the 3rd floor.
- This condo is conveniently located next to the road. Please note that some traffic noise may be heard during your stay.

Parking Details:
A complimentary parking pass for one vehicle is included with your stay. Please note that this pass must be displayed visibly on your vehicle's dashboard at all times. Vehicles without a displayed pass are subject to towing.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
